<p>You think butterflies impacted Auburn’s play Saturday? </p><p>I’m not sure it was butterflies, but their performance sure did <em>turn</em> auburn fans’ stomachs to witness that game.</p><p>I wonder if they’ll have any staff <em>turnover</em>, because of that game? </p><p>All I know is they’re gonna have to <em>turn over</em> a new leaf to improve their play. </p><p>Do you think maybe they served apple <em>turnovers</em> at the pregame meal? (You know…you are what you eat.) </p><p>boog fans, y’all got to figure this out or it could take a <em>turn</em> for the worst.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>(Whew…I’m glad the Aubs only had five <em>turnovers</em>, because that’s all the “<em>turn</em>” scenarios I could come up with.) …OK, that’s enough and shame on all of y’all for enjoying the team down the road’s loss. Alabama could actually lose a game too sometime, you know? </p><p>I know, I know, blasphemy at its finest, but this weekend is going to be a <em>turn</em> of the century type game with Alabama’s new football era beginning just as kirby is trying to double down on georgia’s fleeting success. </p><p>We are just gonna have to <em>turn</em> <em>it over</em> to the Lord!</p><p>(I did have a couple more “<em>turns</em>” in me…feel free to keep it up auburn!)</p><p>I’m not too proud to admit that I’m nervous about this weekend’s game against Georgia. I was even nervous watching the South Florida game because I thought, “This is <em>our</em> team who will face georgia next?!” A bye week makes all the diff, don’t you think? But…eek…georgia had a bye week too.&nbsp;</p><p>The game this weekend is going to be a high stress, high stakes game with former President Trump in attendance, no less, and perhaps a tropical depression visiting, as well. Let’s hope the Tide’s butterflies will be more like the great <em>Muhammad Ali</em>, “<em>Floats like a butterfly, stings like a bee!”</em>&nbsp;</p><p>In prep for the big day’s outcome, everyone needs to do your part this week – exercise, eat right, meditation, say your prayers and for heaven’s sake…do your laundry and wash your lucky drawers! You know you have some, and no one should be wearing second or third string undies for this game. </p><p>People, I’ve never asked this of you before, but it’s time to go to your lucky underwear vault and pull out those <em>2009 Mt. Cody Blocks the Field Goals </em>Alabama vs. Tennessee duds you wore on that glorious day and put them on for this game too. I don’t want to hear any concerns about what if the elastic breaks, and they fall down in the third quarter? True Alabama fans would not let such concerns stifle their dedication. And so what if it does happen? You will receive nothing but admiration and praise from the Alabama fans around you in recognition of your commitment, “<em>Look, you can tell from Joe’s falling drawers he is giving it his all today by wearing his best lucky undies. What a true American.” </em></p><p>Totes worth it and a sure-fire way to conquer your butterflies. Let’s do this!&nbsp;</p><p>(Please let’s) enjoy Week 5 of football season and RTR!</p><p>Jackie&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," height="338" width="482"></p>
